data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"Priority 1: Assert that a failed control append is visible to WorkflowReplayState.digest by deleting _reset() from _commit and expecting the digest test to fail. This gap outranks all others because it silently corrupts the append-only record, the foundational integrity substrate of the entire reasoning harness.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If WorkflowReplayState.digest is proven to have no downstream consumers that rely on its integrity (e.g., it is vestigial), the blast radius is contained and this priority drops.","eval":"observation"},{"case":"If _reset() is found to be dead code that does not actually affect the digest on failed append, the test is vacuous and the gap is mischaracterized.","eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"A mutation that deletes _reset() in the _commit method allows a failed append to go undetected by the digest state. The cheapest regression test directly targets this observable: it performs a control append, triggers a failure, and asserts that the digest reflects the failed state (or that the absence of _reset() causes a test failure). The blast radius is maximal because the digest is the canonical record of state transitions; if it cannot see a failed append, the entire replay and verification audit trail is compromised and downstream consumers operate on a fiction.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
